questions.text:
In February 2023, Cyclone Gabrielle caused extensive damage to roading, water, and farming infrastructure. As climate change is linked to more common adverse weather events, the ability of New Zealand's infrastructure to cope with these weather events has been questioned. When roads, bridges, and other infrastructure are damaged, New Zealand's productive capacity decreases.

Explain why a weather event such as a cyclone leads to lower GDP. Include a definition of GDP in your answer.
questions.expectedAnswer: GDP is the total value of goods and services produced in a country over a period.
questions.markingGuide: Defines GDP and explains how cyclone damage reduces productive capacity and output.
